decision_rule.rule: plan Phase 6 (18 Nov 2026): after two weeks of graded picks, small stakes only if mean CLV against Pinnacle's margin-free close across all graded corner picks is positive with its 95% interval (whole weeks resampled) clear of zero; otherwise no bets, keep tracking, re-check after two more weeks. Win rate and return do not decide.

definition: latest pre-kickoff pick per fixture; return per unit had it been staked; clv_vs_pinnacle_fair = entry odds x Pinnacle power-de-vigged closing probability - 1
